      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/misc/races.lua",
      "source": "While Highers are not meant to rule other humans - and show no particular will to do so - they are frequently called to higher duties.\n\t\tTheir nature grants them better senses than other humans.\n\t\tIncrease blindness immunity by %d%%, maximum sight range by %d, and increases existing infravision, and heightened senses range by %d.\n\t\tAt talent level 5, each time you hit a target you gain telepathy to all similar creatures in radius 15 for 5 turns.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "虽然高等人类并非生来就要统治他人——他们也没有特别的意愿去那样做——但是他们经常承担更高的义务。\n\t\t他们的天性赋予他们比其他人类更敏锐的感官。\n\t\t增加 %d%% 目盲免疫，最大视野范围提高 %d 格，夜视及感应范围提高 %d 格。\n\t\t技能等级 5 时，每次你命中目标，你将获得对 15 格范围内所有同类生物的感知能力，持续 5 回合。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "b1e369a4b20ac2fe215f0d3a1703a848cce3c79766de5df99f8562a93eaa7fa2",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0374 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/techniques/agility.lua",
      "source": "You are trained in an agile, mobile fighting technique combining sling and shield. This allows shields to be equipped, using Dexterity instead of Strength as a requirement.\nWhile you have a shield equip and your Block talent is not on cooldown, you have a %d%% chance to deflect any incoming damage, reducing it by 50%% of your shield’s block value.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "你学会了在战斗中灵敏使用投石索和盾牌的技巧。允许你装备盾牌，用敏捷代替力量需求。\n当你装备盾牌，且格挡技能未进入冷却时，有 %d%% 几率偏转任何受到的伤害，减免相当于盾牌格挡值 50%% 的伤害。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "f40ae004984035a419bd7deed1ea81cd449aa009d94056db14151e8e4da3b537",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0374 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/talents/undeads/ghoul.lua",
      "source": "Gnaw your target for %d%% damage.  If your attack hits, the target may be infected with Ghoul Rot for %d turns.\n\t\tEach turn, Ghoul Rot inflicts %0.2f blight damage.\n\t\tTargets suffering from Ghoul Rot rise as friendly ghouls when slain.\n\t\tGhouls last for %d turns and can use Gnaw, Ghoulish Leap, Stun, and Rotting Disease.\n\t\tThe blight damage scales with your Constitution.",
      "source_tag": "tformat",
      "special": null,
      "target": "啃噬目标，造成 %d%% 伤害。如果你的攻击命中，目标可能感染食尸鬼腐疫，持续 %d 回合。\n\t\t食尸鬼腐疫每回合造成 %0.2f 枯萎伤害。\n\t\t感染食尸鬼腐疫的目标被杀死时，会变成为你作战的友方食尸鬼。\n\t\t这些食尸鬼持续 %d 回合，可以使用啃噬、食尸鬼跳跃、震慑和腐烂疫病。\n\t\t受体质影响，枯萎伤害按比例加成。"
